title: How Much Is a Pound of Gold Worth?
summary: How much is a pound of gold worth? A pound is 14.583 troy ounces, so multiply by the spot price. See a dated example, a table by pounds and live bids.
body_markdown:
A pound of gold came out to $52,126.67 when we looked, 5:27 in the evening Pacific on November 25, 2026. And no, it isn't that anymore, gold doesn't sit still that long. You don't really want our number anyway. You want how we got it so you can do it yourself. Gold's priced by the troy ounce, there are 14.583 of those in a regular pound, you multiply, done. Spot that evening sat at $3,574.40 an ounce and a[1 oz gold bar](https://www.collectpure.com/marketplace/product/random-brand-1-oz-gold-bar-9999-fine-in-card000087) had a $3,587.60 bid on Pure right then.


That's it. The only part anybody gets wrong is which pound.


## How to work out the price of a pound of gold


Spot price per troy ounce, times 14.583.


[Spot](https://www.collectpure.com/blog/what-does-spot-price-mean) is what an ounce of gold goes for before anybody's made it into anything.


Pure's[gold price page](https://www.collectpure.com/charts/gold) had it at $3,574.40 when we looked (5:27 p.m. PT, November 25, 2026). Times 14.5833, with the threes carried all the way out. $52,126.67.


And if you got $52,114.75 you typed 14.58 like everybody does. You're twelve bucks short, the threes after 14.58 keep going.


Fifty-two thousand dollars, for a lump you could lose in a coat pocket. Gold's[density is 19.3](https://pubs.usgs.gov/gip/prospect1/goldgip.html) times water's, so a full pound of it is about a tablespoon and a half of metal. A one pound box of butter is 32 tablespoons.


## How many troy ounces are in a pound of gold?


People get this wrong constantly. Hard to blame them when there really are two different pounds.


The one on your bathroom scale is the avoirdupois pound.[453.592 grams](https://www.nist.gov/pml/special-publication-811/nist-guide-si-appendix-b-conversion-factors/nist-guide-si-appendix-b8) . Divide that by the 31.1035 grams in a troy ounce and out comes 14.583. Then there's the troy pound, which comes out of the old system the troy ounce belongs to. It's only 12 troy ounces, 373.24 grams on that NIST table. About 80 grams lighter than the pound you grew up with.


So whoever tells you a pound of gold is 12 ounces isn't wrong exactly, they're using a pound hardly anybody weighs anything in anymore. Troy pound of gold on the November 25 spot, $42,892.80. Regular pound, $52,126.67. Nine thousand dollars and change, over one word.


If you put something on a normal scale and it read one pound, use 14.583. The gold trade itself skips the whole question. Its[basic unit is the troy ounce](https://pubs.usgs.gov/gip/prospect1/goldgip.html) , with bars stamped in troy ounces, grams or kilos. We wrote up where the unit came from in[what a troy ounce is](https://www.collectpure.com/blog/what-is-a-troy-ounce) if you want the long version.

## What 1 oz and 10 oz gold bars were bidding on Pure


Spot times 14.583 is the metal. It isn't a thing you can hold. Pure doesn't have a one pound gold bar page. The sizes that do exist run in ounces and grams, so we pulled a 1 oz bar and a 10 oz bar.


Pure (collectpure.com) is a peer-to-peer marketplace for gold, silver, platinum, palladium and rare coins. Buyers and sellers set their own prices, and a person on our team checks every item before it ships. So every bar has its own page and the highest bid and lowest ask are just sitting there on it, with how far over spot each one is per ounce, you don't even need an account to look. The over spot columns are the part to look at. That's a few dollars an ounce sitting on top of the metal, $3.25 on the 10 oz bid that evening and $16.00 on the 1 oz. Those are the page's own tags, so don't expect them to reconcile to the cent with the $3,574.40 above. People call it the[premium](https://www.collectpure.com/blog/what-is-a-premium-in-bullion-pricing) . So a pound's worth of actual bars isn't going to match the spot math to the penny, it'll be wherever the bids and asks on those bars happen to be, so you've got to go read them. If you've never looked at one of those bid and ask boxes,[how to read an order book](https://www.collectpure.com/blog/how-to-read-an-order-book) is short.


None of this says where the price goes next. It's multiplication.


## How much is a pound of 14K or 18K gold worth?


All of that is for pure gold, the .9999 fine stuff bars are made of. A pound of old chains and rings, different story.


Karat is parts out of 24. 14K means[14 parts of gold and 10 parts of other metals](https://pubs.usgs.gov/gip/prospect1/goldgip.html) , so 58.3% gold. 18K is 75%, 10K 41.7%. A pound of 14K has about 8.5 troy ounces of actual gold in it (seven twelfths of the pound if you like fractions) and on the November 25 spot that gold came to $30,407. Make it 18K and it's $39,095. 10K, $21,719.


That's gold content and nothing more. Stones and clasps and steel springs weigh something too. What a scrap buyer offers you is a separate number from any of these.


## How to check today's price for a pound of gold


Open[the gold price page](https://www.collectpure.com/charts/gold) , take the per ounce figure, multiply by 14.583. Done. The page also prints gold by the gram and by the kilo, so you can skip the calculator for those.


The bars are easy too. Those[1 oz](https://www.collectpure.com/marketplace/product/random-brand-1-oz-gold-bar-9999-fine-in-card000087) and[10 oz](https://www.collectpure.com/marketplace/product/10-oz-gold-bar-9999-fine-accredited-brand000088) pages are public, whatever the bid and ask are this second is what they show. For any other size, everything from a single gram up to that 400 oz bank bar is worked out in[how much a gold bar is worth](https://www.collectpure.com/blog/how-much-is-a-gold-bar-worth) .


## Questions people ask about a pound of gold


### How much does a pound of gold cost?


The metal is the spot price times 14.583, which came to $52,126.67 on the evening of November 25, 2026. Nobody sells gold by the pound though. What you'd pay is whatever the asks are on real bars that add up to that weight, plus the premium each one carries.


### Can you buy a one pound gold bar?


Not on Pure. There's no product page for one. An item with no page can't be sold on Pure (you can request a new product page). The closest pages on either side are the 10 oz bar, a little over two thirds of a pound, then the kilo at 2.2 pounds.


### Which weighs more, a pound of gold or a pound of feathers?


On a kitchen scale, neither, a pound is a pound. The old riddle only works if the gold was weighed in troy pounds. Then the feathers win, 453.59 grams against 373.24. Ounces go the other way around. An ounce of gold is a troy ounce, 31.1 grams. An ounce of feathers is 28.35.
